caption: The video captures a snowy night town square, where a glass-walled cafe labeled Schipperhuis stands left and two people stand near a fountain beneath a warm-lit tree. Snow falls steadily through the dark air, catching the glow of street lamps and shop windows. A greenish haze develops around the tree, and the image softens as overlapping lights and building outlines appear. The cafe and figures fade into the emerging view, while the tree's lights shift from warm white to bright cyan. The view settles into a row of brick buildings with lit windows, fronted by wet pavement reflecting blue and green illumination. Additional trees wrapped in white lights line the left side of the square. Snow continues to drift past the cyan-lit tree and glowing storefronts.
